query: Who won the 2025 Formula One World Drivers' Championship?
answer: McLaren's Lando Norris won the 2025 Formula One World Drivers' Championship, his first title. He clinched it by finishing third at the season-ending Abu Dhabi Grand Prix [1][2]. He beat Max Verstappen by just two points, 423 to 421, and his teammate Oscar Piastri was also still in the title fight going into that last race [3][1]. The win ended Verstappen's run of four straight titles. Norris became the eleventh British champion and McLaren's first drivers' champion since Lewis Hamilton in 2008 [1][4].
